summary: Reviewed 19 units. Total issues: 8 error, 42 minor (45 with machine patch). Errors: unit 7 Hindi 'हो' turns an apposition into a wish; unit 8 w avaspartaḥ should be the printed vocative avaspartar; unit 10 Hindi 'तुम जैसे' is not in the text; unit 11 Hindi 'अनुत्तेजित न होने वाला' for anānuda; unit 12 Hindi 'शासकों' contradicts English 'instructors'; unit 15 Hindi changes 'deserves' to 'more worthy'; unit 16 Hindi adds the verb 'सौंपना'; unit 19 refrain deviates from the glossary wording. Recurring minors: ṛta in English must be 'order' (units 3, 15, 17); supplied possessives (their share, our thoughts, our offspring); vīrya as valour (unit 14); vāja as prize-contests (unit 13); gram labels for mṛdhaḥ/abhidipsvaḥ/aryaḥ (unit 13), paraḥ (unit 16), asurya (unit 2); the unit 4 text_flag īrase is an invented variant and should be dropped. Units 1 ok. Several units (2, 5, 9, 15-17) remain genuinely obscure and are honestly low confidence. No regrouping suggested.
